title: Pariah's Shield — Just took 7 damage in combat and I'm pretty sure I'm supposed to take 0 -> It's all supposed to go to my creature instead.
scope: Pariah's Shield replacement effect (all damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to equipped creature instead), tested via combat damage from a 7-power attacker; native engine, P0 + P1 human driver seats, protocol-98 driver
result: A1 setup passed (P0 PreCombatMain, Memnite + Shield on P0 board, 7/3 Nyxborn Brute on P1 board, life 20/20). Leg 1 baseline: unblocked Brute with the Shield on board but UNEQUIPPED dealt exactly 7 to P0 (20 -> 13, A2 passed), proving the setup deals damage and mere Shield presence does not prevent it. Leg 2 (reported case): Equip {3} attached the Shield to the Memnite (mid2, A3 passed); the next unblocked 7-power attack left P0 at 13 life (took 0) and put the Memnite in the graveyard (A4 passed) - the 7 damage was redirected to the equipped creature, which died. Zero rejections. The reported 'took 7 damage in combat with Pariah's Shield equipped' does NOT reproduce on v0.99.0.
